Method of Attack: Acts as an in-memory backdoor with remote administration capabilities to maintain persistence on victim networks
Used to backdoor networks of German commercial organizations
Steals sensitive information and may target victims' customers in supply chain attacks
Attack Vector: Exploitation of Zoho AdSelf Service Plus software vulnerabilities
Exploitation of Microsoft Exchange server ProxyLogon vulnerabilities
Indicators of Compromise: Indicators of compromise (IOCs) and YARA rules published by BfV to detect HyperBro infections and connections to APT27 command-and-control servers
